🎬 Wonder (2017)

Wonder follows August “Auggie” Pullman, a bright and kindhearted 10-year-old boy born with facial differences who prepares to attend a mainstream school for the first time after years of being homeschooled. As Auggie enters fifth grade, he faces bullying, uncomfortable stares, and the challenges of making new friends while trying to fit in. With the love and encouragement of his parents, sister, and a few unexpected friends, Auggie gradually discovers the courage to embrace what makes him unique. Through emotional moments, meaningful friendships, and powerful life lessons, Wonder delivers an inspiring story about kindness, acceptance, family, and the importance of looking beyond appearances.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 53m • PG

🎥 Director: Stephen Chbosky

✍️ Writers: Stephen Chbosky, Steve Conrad & Jack Thorne

🏆 Awards: Academy Award nomination for Best Makeup and Hairstyling.

📺 Where to Watch: Available to rent or buy on Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV in the United States. Streaming availability varies by region.
